name: Bork
overview: Bork's Defence level of 300 can be reduced to a minimum of 180 (300 \times 0.6 = 180).

Bork's flat armour and magic resistance scale with the Smorks' remaining health, starting at 8 flat armour and 0 magic resistance at 100% health, and adding 2 flat armour and magic resistance every 25% damage the Smorks take.
